subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 4 – Graded readers: My Dad's a Mechanic & I Want to Be a Scientist!
outcomes: Read 'My Dad's a Mechanic' and explain how Shahad helps her dad.
Read 'I Want to Be a Scientist!' and follow the lab visit.
Talk about rules with must and mustn't.

tf.s: Shahad is helping her dad at the park.
tf.why: She's helping him at his garage.
Yes! He fixes cars in a garage.

tf.s: At first, Shahad mustn't use her skateboard.
Dad is under the white car.
tf.why: Well done! He's under the white car.

tf.s: Dad uses Shahad's skateboard to get his tools and screws.
tf.why: Yes! The skateboard helps him move.

tf.s: Mrs Sumaiya is wearing a white coat.
The children must put a lot of blue powder in the glass.
tf.why: They must only put a little blue powder in.

tf.s: Ahmed is happy when he hears the noise.
tf.why: He's worried when he hears the noise.

tf.s: After the noise stops, they see lots of beautiful colours.
tf.why: Yes! They see lots of beautiful colours.

boxes.q: Where is Shahad helping her dad?
Why mustn't Shahad use her skateboard at first?
Dad can't get his ___ and screws.
boxes.why: He can't get his tools and screws.

boxes.q: What helps Dad move under the car?

boxes.why: Dad is under the white car.

boxes.q: How does Ahmed feel at the noise?
What do they see after the noise?

mcq.q: Where does the story 'My Dad's a Mechanic' happen?
mcq.why: Shahad helps her dad at his garage.

mcq.q: What must the children only put in the glass?
Who is the scientist in the second story?

o: He's under the car and can't get his tools and screws.

mcq.q: Choose a sentence about what Shahad is doing in the garage.
o: She's putting powder in a glass.
mcq.why: Shahad is cleaning the white car.

mcq.q: Choose a good science lab rule.
o: You must listen to the scientist.
You mustn't listen to the scientist.
You must play in the lab.
mcq.why: Listening keeps you safe in the lab.

mcq.q: Complete: 'You mustn't use your skateboard, Shahad. We're working. We ___ playing!'
How does Shahad's idea solve Dad's problem?
o: Dad uses her skateboard to move under the car and get his tools.

mcq.q: Which sentence uses the present continuous?
o: Ahmed is putting a little blue powder in his glass.
You must only put a little blue powder in the glass.
Ahmed wants to be a scientist.
